mapping_policy.rationale: Case-citation labels align directly with LegalAI CASE_CITATION.
Court labels align directly with the LegalAI COURT type.
Date labels align directly with the LegalAI DATE type.
Geo-political entity labels are locations in the LegalAI schema.
Judge labels are mapped to PERSON only for the exact model-predicted span.
Lawyer labels are mapped to PERSON only for the exact model-predicted span.
Organization labels map to LegalAI ORGANIZATION.
Named or other person labels map to PERSON while preserving the observed span.
Legal actor labels are mapped to PERSON only for the exact model-predicted span.
Provision labels are closest to LegalAI SECTION spans.
Legal actor labels are mapped to PERSON only for the exact model-predicted span.
Statute labels align directly with the LegalAI STATUTE type.
Witness labels are mapped to PERSON only for the exact model-predicted span.
